text: Mainly for work and education. Big cities offer a wider range of jobs and universities, whereas villages often have very few options. There's also the attraction of a more exciting social life. The downside is that villages are slowly becoming empty, which means schools and shops close, and the older residents are left without support. I think governments should invest in rural areas to make staying there a realistic choice.

tips.ru: Придаточные и сравнительные конструкции расширяют грамматический диапазон.
tips.example: whereas villages often have very few options

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: The downside is that villages are slowly becoming empty

questions.question: Why do so many young people move from villages to big cities?

text: In some ways, yes. People are in a hurry and often look at their screens instead of greeting each other. Having said that, I don't think it's all bad, because younger people are generally more tolerant and open about different views. I'd say manners haven't disappeared, they've just changed. For instance, a quick message to say thank you is perhaps the modern version of a handwritten letter.

tips.en: Concession phrases show flexible thinking and strengthen the argument.
tips.kk: Келісу тіркестері ойдың икемділігін көрсетеді және дәлелді күшейтеді.
tips.ru: Выражения уступки показывают гибкость мышления и усиливают аргумент.
tips.example: Having said that, I don't think it's all bad

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: For instance, a quick message to say thank you

questions.question: Do you think people are less polite than they used to be?

text: One way is to organise small events, like clean-up days or street festivals, because people care more about a place when they've put their own effort into it. Another idea is to give residents a say in local decisions, such as how to use an empty space. If people feel their opinion counts, they're much more likely to take responsibility. It also helps when the local authorities respond quickly to complaints.

tips.en: Simple spoken linkers help you move smoothly from one idea to the next.
tips.kk: Қарапайым ауызекі байламдар ойдан ойға еркін өтуге көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Простые разговорные связки помогают плавно переходить от мысли к мысли.
tips.example: Another idea is to give residents a say in local decisions

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
tips.example: If people feel their opinion counts

note.en: influence over decisions in the area

questions.question: How can communities encourage people to look after their neighbourhood?

text: Honestly, it's hard to predict. Technology could narrow the gap, since online education reaches people in remote places, but it could just as easily widen it if only wealthy countries control the new industries. I'd like to be optimistic, though. Public awareness of inequality is growing, and that usually puts pressure on politicians to act. So I'd say it will improve slowly, as long as that pressure continues.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.

tips.en: Accurate future forms (will, may, could) show grammatical range when predicting.
tips.kk: Келер шақ формалары (will, may, could) болжам жасағанда грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Верные формы будущего (will, may, could) показывают грамматический диапазон при прогнозах.
